findings.description: Checkout sessions send each cart line to Stripe with quantity 1, so the customer is charged for one unit per product regardless of cart quantity.
reproSteps: Run backend and frontend; open http://127.0.0.1:5173/.
Add two units of Organic Bananas ($3.49 each) and one unit of Avocados ($5.99); confirm cart Total $12.97.
Click Checkout and read the total on the Stripe hosted page, or call POST /api/checkout/session with those items and GET /api/checkout/session-status for amount_total in cents.
findings.observedBehavior: Cart shows $12.97, but Stripe displays $9.48 (one banana and one avocado). API: for two bananas only, session-status reports amount_total 349 (cents) while the cart expects 698 cents.
findings.expectedBehavior: Stripe charged total must equal the in-app cart total (e.g. two bananas at $3.49 charges $6.98 / 698 cents), with line quantities matching the cart.

findings.description: When the cart is empty there is no Checkout control rendered, rather than a disabled Checkout button.
reproSteps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ with an empty cart.
Inspect the cart aside for a Checkout action.
findings.observedBehavior: Cart shows “No items yet.” and no Checkout button is present.
findings.expectedBehavior: Checkout should remain visible and be disabled when the cart is empty so the empty-state affordance is explicit.

findings.description: Product thumbnails from remote image URLs often fail to load, flooding the console with net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED errors during browsing.
reproSteps: Open the shop at http://127.0.0.1:5173/ and load the product grid.
Open the browser developer console and observe failed image requests.
findings.observedBehavior: Multiple errors such as Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED for image URLs (e.g. Unsplash).
findings.expectedBehavior: Images load reliably or fail silently without noisy console errors during routine QA.
